result.summary:
Mavi_CreditMigration (Magento248\app\code\Mavi\CreditMigration) is the Magento back end of the guest "Abre tu credito" wizard. The same 8-step REST sequence serves two products, chosen by the `tipo` parameter of /V1/credito/guest/getRequestInfo (Model/CredilanaManagement.php:82-86):
- APERTURA: origen 'APERTURA CUENTA', articulo forced to AMER00100, fixed condicion '12 M MA P INM' (UEN 1) or '12 M VIU P INM' (UEN 2).
- CREDITO: Credilana new client, origen 'CREDILANA MX', articulo and condicion come from the front end.
UEN comes from the storeCode in the body: 'muebles_america' gives 1, anything else gives 2 (Helper/Data.php:187-189).

Magento keeps a working copy of each request in its own table `mavi_credito_personal` (db_schema.xml:6-54). The row is keyed by a uuid that Magento generates as an HMAC with a hardcoded salt (CredilanaManagement.php:31,100). Each screen writes a `step` number from 1 to 5 to the row, and nothing ever reads it back (CreditRepository::getStep has no callers).

Every back-end call goes through Helper/Data.php, which uses Omnipro\IntelisisIntegration\Model\Adapter::post (Adapter.php:32-44). The Adapter takes a bearer token from omnipro_intelisisintegration/general/endpoint_token and posts to a URL read from core_config_data at mavi_cliente/creditmigration/general/<key>. The URL values are not in code, so the mapping to DMZ routes is inferred from matching names. The likely DMZ routes are credit/CreditoWeb_SaveFirstData, CreditoWeb_SaveData, CreditoWeb_FormDatos, CreditoWeb_Informacion, CreditoWeb_Solicitud, CreditoWeb_SolicitudPrimerGuardado, CreditoWeb_Seguro, ExistRFCAndPhoneCte, codigoRecomendado or codigoRecomendadoWithUen, GetCreditAmounts and SaveImagesProductosMx. All of them except GetCreditAmounts and SaveImagesProductosMx (which use PostSAP to URL_SAP) are forwarded with curl.Post to URL_INTELISIS (LAN). In LAN they run these stored procedures:
- SpCREDISolicitudWebPrimerGuardado (ServicioAndroid)
- SP_CREDITO_WEB_DATOS (ServicioAndroid)
- SP_GeneraConsecutivoCteMavi (IntelisisTmp), which creates the prospect number
- SP_CREDITO_WEB_VALORES_FORM, SPCREDICredilana and SpVTASVentaCupon (IntelisisTmp)

The guest sequence is:
1. getRequestInfo creates the pre-request (SaveFirstData) and a Hazten transaction.
2. sendNip / validateNip (SMS NIP).
3. setData: personal data. RFC is computed locally by Mavi\ProductosMX\Model\RFC, then checked with ExistRFCAndPhoneCte.
4. setAddress: the postal code is looked up with GET_CP.
5. setReference: one reference.
6. sendRequest or sendRequestNoBiometric:
   - CreditoWeb_SaveData 'Insert_2' creates the request in SP_CREDITO_WEB_DATOS and the prospect account, and returns "idSolicitud/prospect".
   - SaveIdDatosTemp links the request to the pre-request.
   - The promoter coupon is burned as 'PW'+id.
   - A second CreditoWeb_SaveData 'Update' sets estatus 8 plus the card and mortgage flags. LAN runs it fire-and-forget after 10 s.
   - The INE and selfie images are posted to url_save_next_form.
   - A Hazten row is written to mavi_hazten_credit_transaction, and Hazten validation starts.

After that, the cron mavi_hazten_sync_cron sends the biometric result to LAN (SIGMAVI.dbo.CREDIHBiometrico). The credit analysis and the prospect-to-client conversion are not in Magento; they happen downstream on the LAN or Intelisis side, which other tracers cover.

The client/* endpoints (authenticated, existing account) are a separate flow: Credilana for existing customers, plus life insurance. It is not account opening. It uses SPCREDICredilana operations (ValidaSesion, PrimerGuardado, SaveNip, SendNip, ValNip, CteInfo, banco) and CreditoWeb_Seguro 'Solicitud' / 'SeguroDeVida' (SpCREDICredilanaSeguroDeVida).

No Magento view or JS calls /V1/credito/*. The screens ("Solicitar ahora", "Verificar y continuar") live in a decoupled front end that is not on the share.

Migration status: ServicioSAP HEAD exposes only codigoPromocion, GetCreditAmounts and SaveImagesProductosMx from this set. Its SolicitudCreditoWebMethods.InsertAsync is called only from the order flow (OrderMethods.cs:792). In the DMZ working copy (branch ConexionSAP), URL_INTELISIS equals URL_SAP, so as configured there the CreditoWeb_* calls would reach ServicioSAP routes that do not exist.

SaveFirstData data[0..14] = [0,'','','','',tel,uen,0,0,origen,0,articulo,0,'','']. out: [{uuid, articulo, telefono, ...personal fields, transaction_id?, liveness_link?}] (entity_id, solicitud, rfc, origen, step and uen are removed at :161-172).

steps.notes: (1) saveTempTransaction runs even when Hazten is disabled. ValidationTransactionDto::getTransactionId() returns a non-nullable string (ValidationTransactionDto.php:20-23), so a missing transaction_id throws a TypeError; hence the separate NoBiometric endpoint. (2) The catch at :588-590 only catches WebApiException and replaces the message. (3) The DMZ SaveImagesRequest model has no pruebaDeVida field (DMZ Models/CreditRequest.cs:122-127), so the liveness image is dropped. (4) LAN 'Update' calls cte_prospecto() again (CredyPrestamoMethods.cs:33), consuming an extra consecutive number. (5) Magento sends the images before LAN's delayed Update runs.

jobs: mavi_hazten_sync_cron: Mavi/Hazten/etc/crontab.xml:4-6 -> Cron/SyncTransaction.php:29-54. Schedule from mavi_cliente/hazten/cron_settings/cron_frecuency. Pushes unsynced Hazten transactions to api_sync (DMZ credit/SaveHaztenTransaction -> LAN SIGMAVI.CREDIHBiometrico).
LAN fire-and-forget: CreditoWeb_SaveData op Update runs after Task.Delay(10000) (LAN CreditController.cs:409-415).
LAN fire-and-forget: SaveImagesProductosMx writes files after a 10 s delay (LAN CreditMethods.cs:970-990; also kept in ServicioSAP per its CreditController.cs:175-177).
LAN fire-and-forget: ProcesoAsynCredilanaCte after CreditoWeb_Seguro 'Solicitud' (LAN CreditController.cs:392-395; CredyPrestamoMethods.cs:553). Existing-client flow only.

No cron in Mavi_CreditMigration itself. config.xml <apertura><need_days>0</need_days><minium_days>30</minium_days> (etc/config.xml:5-8) and CreditRepository::getDayAfterUpdated (Service/CreditRepository.php:83-88) are never read or called: an unimplemented re-application window.
gemini_corrections: Confirmed: the screen texts are not in Magento code. No .js, .phtml or .html in app/ calls /V1/credito/*; the only references are webapi.xml and the PHP classes. The screen belongs to a decoupled front end that is not on the share.

Corrected for this module: Mavi_CreditMigration is NOT a pure REST proxy with no SQL. It persists the whole wizard in its own Magento table mavi_credito_personal (Service/CreditRepository.php:34-36; db_schema.xml:6-54). Through Mavi_Hazten it writes mavi_hazten_credit_transaction (BiometricManagement.php:130-142), and through Omnipro codigoPromocion it saves quote.bank (CreditoManagement.php:601). It also computes the RFC locally (ProductosMX RFC.php:123) and calls Hazten and AWS directly, not through the DMZ.

Missing from Gemini: the APERTURA vs CREDITO split is decided by the `tipo` parameter of guest/getRequestInfo (CredilanaManagement.php:84-86). It changes articulo (AMER00100), origen ('APERTURA CUENTA' vs 'CREDILANA MX', Helper/Data.php:195-201) and condicion/sucursal at submit (:431-435). UEN is derived from storeCode (muebles_america=1, otherwise 2), not hardcoded to 1, in this module (Helper/Data.php:187-189). The Mavi_CreditRequest 'UEN=1' claim was not checked in T1.

Missing from Gemini: the request is created in two phases. First a pre-request through SpCREDISolicitudWebPrimerGuardado (SaveFirstData, ServicioAndroid). Then the real request plus prospect account through SP_CREDITO_WEB_DATOS 'Insert' and SP_GeneraConsecutivoCteMavi, returned to Magento as 'idSolicitud/prospect' (CredyPrestamoMethods.cs:206-208). A second 'Update' sets estatus 8, and the images go to the LAN file share and AdminDoc.MAVI_DOC_CTE.
open_questions: Actual core_config_data values for mavi_cliente/creditmigration/general/* (especially url_save_next_form, url_codigo_recomendador and url_rfc_validation) per environment. The DMZ route mapping in T1 is inferred from matching names. The Magento team can run a read-only SELECT path, scope_id, value FROM core_config_data WHERE path LIKE 'mavi_cliente/creditmigration/%' OR path LIKE 'mavi_cliente/hazten/general/url_api' OR path LIKE 'mavi_cliente/hazten/general/api_sync'. Values are hostnames; do not export api_key.

Where is the decoupled front-end repository (Vue Storefront/PWA) holding 'Abre tu credito' / 'Solicitar ahora' / 'Verificar y continuar'? It is needed to confirm the screen order and which tipo value (exact case) is sent. Magento's getOrigen is case-sensitive (Helper/Data.php:195-201).

Is SMS NIP validation enforced anywhere server-side for the guest flow? Magento never checks validateNip's result before sendRequest, and `step` is written but never read. client/sendRequest trusts a client-sent `validacion` (ClientCreditManagement.php:100-101). Check whether SpCREDISolicitudWebPrimerGuardado or SP_CREDITO_WEB_DATOS rejects unvalidated phones.
Who sends the SMS for SaveNip (inside SpCREDISolicitudWebPrimerGuardado, or another process)? LAN returns '0' for SaveNip because there is no result branch (CreditMethods.cs:568-602).

DMZ working copy: URL_INTELISIS equals URL_SAP (same localhost base). Is this the intended configuration? ServicioSAP HEAD c1cfcbc has no credit/CreditoWeb_SaveFirstData, CreditoWeb_SaveData, CreditoWeb_FormDatos, CreditoWeb_Informacion, CreditoWeb_Seguro, CreditoWeb_Solicitud(PrimerGuardado), ExistRFCAndPhoneCte, codigoRecomendado(WithUen) or SaveHaztenTransaction routes (ServicioSAP Controllers/CreditController.cs only has SendSmsNewNumber, codigoPromocion, getSms, validateSms, getPlazos, GetCreditAmounts, guardardocumento, SaveImagesProductosMx, condicionespago). The vault (FLUJO_CREDITO_LAN_VS_SAP.md:69-70) says apertura 'sigue en LAN'.
Is the APERTURA amounts catalog (montos_cte_nuevo_apertura) expected on the apertura screen? Magento always sends tipo='CREDITO' (CredilanaManagement.php:69).
Should the liveness image (prueba_de_vida) reach the back end? The DMZ SaveImagesRequest has no such field (DMZ Models/CreditRequest.cs:122-127).

With Hazten enabled, does getFlowId work in production? trim() receives the store id as its character mask (HaztenRequestHelper.php:68), and flow_id is declared showInDefault=0 (Hazten system.xml:33).

Security, for the owner to decide (not acted on): client/getClienteInfo returns full phone and CLABE data for any 10-digit account to any logged-in customer, ignoring clienteId (ClientCreditManagement.php:60-95). LAN codigoRecomendado builds SQL with string.Format (LAN CreditMethods.cs:1117-1119). LAN Connection.cs:26-35 hardcodes DB and file-share credentials. LAN stores the Hazten Apikey in SIGMAVI.CREDIHBiometrico.ClaveApi (CreditMethods.cs:2345). The uuid HMAC salt is hardcoded (CredilanaManagement.php:31).

wrong.claim: Step 4 / LAN backend: 'CURPValidation returns no error immediately at :1425, so the CURP checks are dead code. RFCValidation follows.' This implies the RFC/phone duplicate check in LAN is live and that the HTTP 409 in setData/sendRequest can fire.
wrong.correction: Both checks are dead. RFCValidation also returns {Error=false, 'Puede continuar con la solicitud.'} on its first line, so the Cte/CTETEl/CteEnviarA queries after it never run. In LAN, ExistRFCAndPhoneCte always returns Error=false. The 409 at CredilanaManagement.php:215-216 and :424-425 can never fire through LAN. In saveRequest the 409 would be swallowed anyway: the catch at :588-590 rethrows a generic message.

wrong.claim: C1 note: 'getClienteInfo ... returns the full phone and last-4 CLABE plus bank for any 10-digit account'.
wrong.correction: The last-4 masking never takes effect. LAN reads the CLABE row with `if (!reader.Read()) {...}` and then `while (reader.Read()) {...}`, and the query is a TOP 1 subquery. So when a validated CLABE exists, the first Read consumes the only row, the while loop never runs, and accInfo[2]/[3] keep the raw value from SPCREDICredilana 'CteInfo' column 2/3. That SP source was not read, so its masking is unknown. When no row exists, LAN returns '****', and Magento turns that into an empty clabe. The phone is res[4] from the SP and Magento does not mask it. The IDOR concern (clienteId ignored, ClientCreditManagement.php:70) stands, but 'last-4' is not what the code delivers.
wrong.evidence: LAN CreditMethods.cs:1246-1281 (query uses dbo.FnVTASMuestraCuatro at :1250, but assignment only inside while at :1271-1277 after the if(!reader.Read()) at :1266); Magento ClientCreditManagement.php:79-83.

wrong.claim: Step 1 note: when Hazten is enabled, getFlowId 'flow_id is read at default scope' (trim receives the store id as its character mask).
wrong.correction: getHaztenConfig('flow_id') is called without a storeId, so it uses SCOPE_STORE with a null store. That resolves to the store of the current REST request (the store code in the /rest/<code>/ URL), not default scope and not the storeCode sent in the body. The trim() misuse also has its own effect: it strips characters equal to the store-id digits from both ends of the flow id (store id 1 strips leading and trailing '1's). The storeCode argument is only used to build that bad mask.

wrong.claim: SP table for SpCREDISolicitudWebPrimerGuardado: '(pre-request table written inside SpCREDISolicitudWebPrimerGuardado)'; source 'not read in T1'; SMS for SaveNip 'sent by the SP or a downstream process; not visible'.
wrong.correction:
The SP source is in the vault and answers this. All of the following are in ServicioAndroid:
- SaveFirstData: INSERT CREDIDSolicitudWebDatosPrimerGuardado. Importe is looked up through linked server ERPMAVI.IntelisisTmp.dbo.art, or PropreListaDFinal + VTASCCondicionesCredVtaLinea for 'PRODUCTOS MX'.
- UpdateFirstData / UpdateFirstDom / SaveIdDatosTemp: UPDATE of the same table.
- SaveRef: INSERT or UPDATE CREDIDRefPrimerGuardadoCredWeb. NumReferencia comes from @uen, which is data[6]=1, and TipoTel comes from @nip, which is data[7]=1 ('Celular'). This is positional reuse, not a UEN.
- SaveNip: generates a random 6-digit NIP and writes it to the pre-request. It queues the SMS by inserting into TcAAea00030_EnvioMensajes (IdMensaje 14, Cliente 'CW00001', Clave=@ClaveMensaje) and logs to CREDIHSolicitudWebHistoricoNip.
- ValNip: only compares the NIP and returns validacion. It never writes Validacion=1.

wrong.claim: SP_CREDITO_WEB_DATOS: 'tables: (tables written by SP_CREDITO_WEB_DATOS)', source 'vault ANALISIS... (not re-read)'.
wrong.correction:
The source exists at SPsOrden\SP_CREDITO_WEB_DATOS.sql.
- Insert: writes ServicioAndroid.dbo.CRED_SOLICITUD_WEB_DATOS_TEMP and returns SCOPE_IDENTITY. It reads ERPMAVI.IntelisisTmp.dbo.TablaStD and CteTel through the linked server, and the local TcAAEA00030_EnvioMensajes.
- Update: changes 9 columns (estatus, codigo, extencionArchivo_1..3, tarjeta, tarjetaDigitos, creditoHipoteca, creditoAutomotriz) WHERE id=@Id and echoes @Id. It does NOT touch cliente, so the second cte_prospecto() call only burns a consecutive number. It does not overwrite the prospect.
- Neither branch checks the NIP validation of the pre-request.
wrong.evidence: SPsOrden\SP_CREDITO_WEB_DATOS.sql:172-215 (Insert, ERPMAVI reads), :346-348, :351-368 (Update); grep for 'PrimerGuardado' in that file returns nothing; vault ANALISIS_SP_CREDITO_WEB_DATOS.md:30-39.

wrong.claim: Step 8 backend: 'INE files go to C:\inetpub\wwwroot\api\images\credit\{uid}_{n}.jpg and the selfie to AdminDoc MAVI_DOC_CTE TIPO_DOC 14'.
wrong.correction: The selfie goes to both places: AdminDoc.MAVI_DOC_CTE (TIPO_DOC 14, IDAPLICACION 7) and the file share as {uid}_3.jpg. All three files use the same name, the sha1 uid from Magento.

wrong.claim: Step 9: 'LAN CreditMethods.SaveHaztenTransaction ... coordinates saved first' (tables listed: only SIGMAVI.CREDIHBiometrico).
wrong.correction: Coordinates are saved by reading ServicioAndroid.CRED_SOLICITUD_WEB_DATOS_TEMP.cliente by id and then inserting into IntelisisTmp.dbo.RM0855ACoordenadasProspecto. The call passes (Longitude, Latitude) into the parameters (latitude, longitude), so COORDENADAS is stored as '(lon , lat)'. The cron also writes SIGMAVI.CREDIDEtapaProcesamiento and SIGMAVI.CREDIDTransaccionMetaDato.
wrong.evidence: LAN CreditMethods.cs:2304-2306 (calls), :2433-2466 (SaveCoordsInNewTable signature (long id, string latitude, string longitude), reads CRED_SOLICITUD_WEB_DATOS_TEMP on sCadenaConexionAndriod, inserts RM0855ACoordenadasProspecto on sCadenaConexion), :2414/:2478 (CREDIDEtapaProcesamiento), :2423/:2508 (CREDIDTransaccionMetaDato).

wrong.claim: Step 1 notes: 'If SaveFirstData returns null it is only logged, and setSolicitud(null) then throws a TypeError' (presented as the failure mode of the pre-request).
wrong.correction: This is true only for transport failures: the DMZ Curl.Post returns e.ToString() and the Adapter returns false, so json_decode gives null. When the SP returns no row, LAN returns the string '0', so Magento stores solicitud='0' and continues silently. Every later SaveFirstData op then targets IdSolicitudWebDatosPrimerGuardado=0.
wrong.evidence: LAN CreditMethods.cs:568-576 (res defaults to "0"); DMZ Helper/Curl.cs:108-111; Magento CredilanaManagement.php:97-106; Model/Credit.php:81 (setSolicitud(string)).

missing.what: There is no server-side phone (NIP) validation anywhere in the guest opening flow. ValNip in the SP only compares and returns. Nothing writes Validacion=1 for the guest flow: Magento never sends UpdateValNip, and SaveNip always sends validacion=0. SP_CREDITO_WEB_DATOS never reads the pre-request. So sendRequest succeeds without the NIP ever being validated.
missing.evidence: SpCREDISolicitudWebPrimerGuardado.sql:189-205 (SaveNip sets Validacion=@validacion, Magento data[8]=0 at CredilanaManagement.php:805), :268-286 (ValNip no UPDATE), :460-467 (UpdateValNip, never sent by Magento); CredilanaManagement.php:387-414 (no step/validation check).

missing.what: SMS abuse surface: POST /V1/credito/guest/sendNip is anonymous, and each call to SaveNip with validacion!=1 generates a new NIP and queues an SMS row in ServicioAndroid.TcAAea00030_EnvioMensajes. Magento has no throttle or CAPTCHA. The SMS is sent by whatever process consumes that queue, which is outside these repos (an undocumented job).

The 2026-09-04 SP change ('hash in messages', @ClaveMensaje) is not fed by LAN. CreditoWeb_SaveFirstData passes 16 parameters and omits @ClaveMensaje, so TcAAea00030_EnvioMensajes.Clave is always NULL for this flow.

Changing the product in getRequestInfo (existing uuid) updates Magento but not LAN. The SP's UpdateFirstData branch does not set Articulo or Importe, so the pre-request keeps the first articulo and amount, while Magento and the final Insert_2 (datos[33]) use the new one.

Lowercase tipo is accepted but mis-classified. getRequestInfo upper-cases tipo for validation and the AMER00100 decision (:84-86), but getOrigen() is case-sensitive. 'apertura' or 'credito' in lowercase is therefore stored with origen 'DESCONOCIDO', which has these effects:
- condicion falls into the fixed '12 M ... P INM' branch, even for credito (:431-433).
- @origen='DESCONOCIDO' is sent to SP_CREDITO_WEB_DATOS.
- LAN GetAtencionClientes falls through to SP_CREDITO_WEB_VALORES_FORM instead of SQLite.
The tracer noted the case-sensitivity but not these downstream effects.

In sendRequest (biometric endpoint), saveTempTransaction and Hazten run after the request is already created in LAN: Insert_2, SaveIdDatosTemp, coupon burn, Update and images are all done by then. If transaction_id is missing, getTransactionId() throws a TypeError. That is not a WebApiException, so it escapes the catch and returns HTTP 500 even though the request and prospect exist. A client retry creates a duplicate request and burns another consecutive number. A Hazten startValidation failure also throws a WebApiException after creation, which gets the generic message.

setData and setAddress declare `biometric` (ValidationTransactionDtoInterface) as a required, non-nullable REST parameter. The front end therefore has to send a biometric object even when Hazten is disabled, or Magento input validation rejects the call.
missing.evidence: CredilanaManagement.php:180,268 (signatures); usage only inside isEnabled() blocks :233-246,:300-316.

missing.what: Omnipro codigoPromocion side effect in REST context: there is no session quote, so _checkoutSession->getQuote()->setBank($codigo)->save() most likely creates and saves a new orphan quote row on each call, from both the validate step and the 'Elimina' burn in sendRequest. It also swallows every exception and returns null, which CredilanaManagement maps to 'invalid code'. The 'Elimina' response is ignored in sendRequest. (Plausible: Magento runtime behavior, not executed.)

Linked server and DB inventory gaps:
- Linked server ERPMAVI (IntelisisTmp) is used by both PrimerGuardado and SP_CREDITO_WEB_DATOS.
- sCadenaComercializadora (MAVICUBOS / Comercializadora) is referenced by the dead CURPValidation.
- DMZ Curl now logs in only against URL_SAP (login/auth); the LAN login is commented out. Even if URL_INTELISIS were pointed back to LAN, LAN routes would receive the ServicioSAP token.
missing.evidence: SpCREDISolicitudWebPrimerGuardado.sql:60,66-67; SP_CREDITO_WEB_DATOS.sql:178,187-198; LAN Conn/Connection.cs:31; LAN CreditMethods.cs:1429; DMZ Helper/Curl.cs:61-84,102.

missing.what: Per-call authentication overhead. The Magento Adapter fetches a new DMZ token on every post, with no caching, and each DMZ Curl instance logs into ServicioSAP in its constructor. So every wizard call costs at least 2 Magento-to-DMZ HTTP calls plus a ServicioSAP login, and Curl.Post failures come back as HTTP 200 with exception text.

The cron group 'mavi' used by mavi_hazten_sync_cron is defined in another module (Mavi_ThreeDSecure). The cron fetches every sync=0 row on each run with no retry cap or error state. In LAN, a missing CRED_SOLICITUD_WEB_DATOS_TEMP row throws a NullReferenceException (ExecuteScalar().ToString()), so such rows retry forever.

Field-length limits in mavi_credito_personal that the tracer did not note:
- origen varchar(15) fits 'APERTURA CUENTA' exactly (15 characters).
- telefono varchar(10) and tipo_antiguedad varchar(1) are not validated in getRequestInfo or setAddress, so longer input is truncated or fails depending on SQL mode.
- The primary key column is misspelled 'entitiy_id'.

verify.confidence:
High for the Magento, DMZ and LAN C# points, all re-read line by line: CredilanaManagement.php, Helper/Data.php, Credit.php, db_schema.xml, webapi.xml, ClientCreditManagement.php, SegurosDeVidaManagement.php, Hazten module, Omnipro Adapter, DMZ CreditController.cs, Curl.cs and Models/CreditRequest.cs, LAN CreditController.cs, CreditMethods.cs and CredyPrestamoMethods.cs.

High for the SP points, read from the vault SQL files SpCREDISolicitudWebPrimerGuardado.sql and SP_CREDITO_WEB_DATOS.sql.

Most of T1's file:line citations, endpoint list, APERTURA vs CREDITO branching, DMZ routes, URL_INTELISIS == URL_SAP (localhost) in the DMZ working copy, and the ServicioSAP route list are confirmed. Two items are inference or plausible only: the orphan-quote side effect, and the actual core_config_data URL mapping (not readable without SQL). SPCREDICredilana, SP_CREDITO_WEB_VALORES_FORM and SpVTASVentaCupon sources were not checked.

title: Magento: the other credit modules and where the flow is born

result.summary:
WHERE IT IS BORN. Magento 2.4.8 has two different ways to open a credit account, and neither one contains the screen texts "Apertura de cuenta", "Abre tu credito", "Verificar y continuar" or "Solicitar ahora". A ripgrep over app/code (*.html, *.phtml, *.js, *.xml, *.csv, *.php) and over app/design found none of them.

(A) Opening WITHOUT merchandise (tipo=APERTURA). This is a headless flow: an external frontend calls Mavi\CreditMigration /V1/credito/*. CredilanaManagement.php:84-86 accepts APERTURA, forces the article AMER00100 and sets origen 'APERTURA CUENTA' (Helper/Data.php:197). The page that shows the "Credito Muebles America / Solicitar ahora / Verificar y continuar" screen is not in this repo. The best lead is the PWA share \\CATECINF214230D\mavi-pwa, which the vault access guide mentions and which could not be reached from here. Magento's own redirects also point to an external storefront (config omnipro_checkout/general/url_return_vuestore, used in Omnipro\MaviCredito Controller/Webhook/Result.php:27 and ProductosMX Block/Index.php:183). CMS blocks live in the database and were not checked. That flow belongs to tracer T1.

(B) Opening WITH merchandise ("Productos MX"). This flow is fully inside Magento. It starts in the native Magento checkout:
- The customer picks payment method omnipro_pago_credito ("Mi Crédito", Omnipro_MaviCredito) and chooses type 'guest'. The 'guest' type is the new-customer path; the existing-client path needs an account C########.
- The JS (Omnipro_MaviCredito omnipro_pago_credito-method.js:670-740) saves the payment information and then POSTs a hidden form with field 'payload' to /productosmx. Existing clients go to /creditocheckout instead, and that controller redirects to /productosmx when the account is empty (CreditoCheckout Controller/Index/Index.php:121-126).
- productosmx_index_index renders a 5-section Knockout wizard: Validación de teléfono, Verificación de identidad (INE front/back, selfie, Hazten liveness), Datos Generales, Referencia Personal, Autenticación de Buró.
- The wizard calls the guest REST API /V1/productosmx/guest/:cartId/*. Every call goes through Omnipro\IntelisisIntegration\Model\Adapter: it first POSTs Username/Password to omnipro_intelisisintegration/general/endpoint_token, strips the quotes from the returned token, and sends it as a Bearer token to the URL stored under a mavi_checkout/productosmx/general/* config key.
- On the DMZ these land on CreditoWeb_SaveFirstData (ops SaveFirstData, UpdateFirstData, SaveNip, ValNip, UpdateFirstDom, SaveRef, SaveIdDatosTemp), CreditoWeb_SaveData_Articulos (ops Insert_2 and then Update), CreditoWeb_FormDatos, customerService/validarCoberturaPorCP and codigoRecomendado. All of these go to the LAN through curl.Post to URL_INTELISIS. SaveImagesProductosMx is the exception: it goes to ServicioSAP through PostSAP.
- Hazten biometrics are called directly from Magento (Mavi\Hazten HaztenManagement, using the API key from mavi_cliente/hazten/general/*), not through the DMZ.
- saveRequest does NOT create a Magento sales_order. It takes a local increment_id (7000000001+ for VIU, 8000000001+ for MA) from table mavi_productos_mx, writes mavi_hazten_credit_transaction, and dispatches mavi_new_credit_request. An observer then inserts into mavi_invoice_new_orders.
- The success page deactivates the quote and shows "CRÉDITO PRE-AUTORIZADO" plus the prospect id.

AFTER THE REQUEST IS SAVED (Magento side):
- Cron mavi_hazten_sync_cron sends the Hazten transaction to DMZ credit/SaveHaztenTransaction, which goes to LAN and inserts into SIGMAVI CREDIHBiometrico.
- Cron mavi_prospect_tracking_cron (hourly) polls DMZ credit/getCreditAccount/{prospect}. On the LAN that reads CREDIHProspectoACliente to detect the prospect-to-client conversion (C account). It then sends a GA4 Measurement Protocol event "Paso 9 - Confirmación Exitosa" and stores c_account.
- Cron mavi_invoice_data_analysis_check_for_invoices polls Intelisis statuses through the url_statuses config, which is probably DMZ order/GetIntelisisStatuses (inferred from the payload, not confirmed). When a request reaches CONCLUIDO it dispatches mavi_invoice_order_completed.
- No module in this tracer contains the credit analysis or the liberador itself. Those happen in Intelisis/LAN.

THE OTHER MODULES are not the opening flow. They belong to existing-client credit purchases or to account utilities:
- Mavi_CreditoCheckout (requestCreditOrder, authorizationResult callback from the LAN liberador, cron PollCreditStatus every 5 minutes, table omnipro_credito_pending).
- Omnipro_MaviCredito (SMS/NIP for account C########, saldo, factura, coupon, CancelOrders cron).
- Mavi_CreditRequest: a read of a client's credit requests.
- GenerarRFC, RecuperarCuenta, JoinAccount, CuentaMavi, OtpService (password reset by e-mail; not credit), PlazoCredito, CredilanaConfig (only a Credilana button switch), LeyendaClienteNuevo (coverage by postal code for new customers, used before entering ProductosMX).
- VueStorefront\CartSync is a third-party Divante cart-sync controller (/vue/cart/sync) with no credit logic.

LABELS: ProductosMX is "Apertura de cuenta con mercancía". The vault (FLUJO_CREDITO_LAN_VS_SAP.md:69-70) says it is still on LAN, with SP_CREDITO_WEB_DATOS called with @Op 'Insert_2' and 'Update'. That is outside the @Op='Insert' scope of the SAP migration. Credilana (tipo CREDITO, origen 'CREDILANA MX') shares the CreditMigration API but is out of scope for the migration.

MISSED BY GEMINI: account opening WITH merchandise runs entirely inside Magento in Mavi_ProductosMX. The page /productosmx is reached from checkout payment 'Mi Crédito' with type 'guest' (omnipro_pago_credito-method.js:714-739). It is a 5-section wizard with its own /V1/productosmx/guest/:cartId/* API, direct Hazten biometrics plus AWS S3 uploads, and DMZ calls to CreditoWeb_SaveFirstData / CreditoWeb_SaveData_Articulos (LAN) and SaveImagesProductosMx (ServicioSAP).

WRONG: the Omnipro_MaviCredito endpoints are not a 'pure REST proxy with no SQL'. They write Magento tables: omnipro_credito_sms (CreditoManagement.php:363-371, :415, :465), the customer EAV attribute customer_temp_cash_account (:422-427) and quote.bank (:601). They also set session values. getUrlRegistro makes NO DMZ call at all: it reads sales_order and returns a URL built from config registro_url plus PHP-serialized order and customer data (:469-552). These endpoints serve EXISTING clients (account C########), not account opening. validateUserNewNumber goes to the DMZ SendSmsNewNumber, which is routed to ServicioSAP (PostSAP, DMZ CreditController.cs:302-308), not to the LAN.

WRONG: Mavi_CreditRequest::getCreditRequest does not 'set UEN=1 and send the payload to the ERP'. uen is 1 only when storeCode=='muebles_america', otherwise 2 (CreditRequest.php:62). It is a READ that sends {cliente_id, uen} to mavi_cliente/credit_request/general/url_credit_request and returns the client's credit requests; the config comment says 'Obtiene la información de los créditos del cliente'. It requires an authenticated customer (resource 'self', webapi.xml:6-10) and is not part of the opening flow.

ADDITION: the Adapter is not a plain proxy. Before every call it does a token round-trip: POST Username/Password (encrypted config) to endpoint_token, take the body with its quotes stripped, then send it as a Bearer token (Adapter.php:32-87). Each module's DMZ URL lives in its own core_config_data key, not in code.

title: DMZ routes used by the opening flow

result.summary:
The DMZ (DMZ\WebApiMagento, branch ConexionSAP, HEAD 09cb341, one uncommitted change in OrdersController.cs that only comments out logging) is a thin router. It does almost no logic of its own. Each controller action builds `new Curl()`, and that constructor logs in to ServicioSAP only: it POSTs USER_SAP to URL_SAP + "login/auth" (Helper\Curl.cs:73-90). The LAN login is commented out (Curl.cs:61-71), and line 84 sets Token = TokenSAP, so the "LAN" calls Post/Get to URL_INTELISIS also carry the ServicioSAP JWT. PostSAP, GetSAP and PatchSAP go to URL_SAP.

Configuration finding: in the Web.config on the share, URL_INTELISIS and URL_SAP hold the same loopback URL (lines 17 and 19). The real hosts are commented out on lines 16 and 18. Web.config is not tracked in git; it was deleted in commit 2caa18c. Today, then, every "LAN" route also lands on the ServicioSAP host. The audit doc records this as a deliberate test setup (AUDITORIA_INTEGRAL_LAN_DMZ_SAP.md:183).

Magento authenticates to the DMZ with Omnipro\IntelisisIntegration\Model\Adapter.php:64-87. It POSTs {Username, Password} (config omnipro_intelisisintegration/general/user, pass, endpoint_token) to the DMZ login/authenticate route (LoginController.cs:16-37, which checks hashes against USER_HASH/USER_SALT and PASS_HASH/PASS_SALT and returns a JWT built from JWT_SECRET_KEY, JWT_AUDIENCE_TOKEN, JWT_ISSUER_TOKEN and JWT_EXPIRE_MINUTES). Magento then sends Bearer calls. Every endpoint URL Magento uses is a core_config_data value, not in code. The Magento-to-DMZ route mapping below is therefore proven by request-body shape and module naming. The one exception is CreditoCheckout, which builds the order/* URLs by code from the setOrder endpoint.

Opening flow ("APERTURA CUENTA", Mavi\CreditMigration guest flow) as seen by the DMZ:
- credit/CreditoWeb_FormDatos (form catalogs) -> LAN SQLite cache or SP_CREDITO_WEB_VALORES_FORM.
- credit/CreditoWeb_Informacion (Dimas legend, banks, NIP) -> LAN SPCREDICredilana or SQLite.
- credit/GetCreditAmounts -> ServicioSAP (SQLite).
- credit/CreditoWeb_SaveFirstData (ops SaveFirstData, UpdateFirstData, UpdateFirstDom, SaveRef, SaveNip, ValNip, SaveIdDatosTemp) -> LAN SpCREDISolicitudWebPrimerGuardado (ServicioAndroid).
- credit/ExistRFCAndPhoneCte -> LAN inline SQL on Cte, CteTel, CteEnviarA, Venta, MOVBITACORA.
- credit/codigoRecomendadoWithUen -> LAN reads CREDIDCodigoRecomendador.
- credit/CreditoWeb_SaveData (Insert_2, then Update) -> LAN SP_GeneraConsecutivoCteMavi plus SP_CREDITO_WEB_DATOS, plus inserts into TrWACW00041_RefSolCredWeb.
- credit/codigoPromocion (Elimina) -> LAN SpVTASVentaCupon.
- credit/SaveImagesProductosMx -> ServicioSAP; writes MAVI_DOC_CTE and the image share.
- credit/SaveHaztenTransaction (Magento cron) -> LAN; writes SIGMAVI CREDIHBiometrico and related tables.
- credit/getCreditAccount/{prospect} (Magento hourly cron) -> LAN reads CREDIHProspectoACliente (prospect -> client tracking).

The ProductosMX variant uses the same SaveFirstData route, plus credit/CreditoWeb_SaveData_Articulos (which also inserts article lines via SpVTASInsertArtSolCreditoLinea) and customerService/validarCoberturaPorCP. The existing-client Credilana flow (labelled CREDILANA, not APERTURA) adds CreditoWeb_SolicitudPrimerGuardado, CreditoWeb_Seguro and CreditoWeb_Solicitud. CreditoWeb_Seguro op Solicitud starts the LAN Liberador. Checkout credit uses getSms, validateSms, SendSmsNewNumber, GetPhoneValidatedClientSecretName, order/setOrder -> ServicioSAP order/new, order/creditStatus, order/updateCreditOrderId and order/authorizationResult. Reverse calls into Magento go through magento/setCuenta and order/setCAccount.

ServicioSAP (HEAD c1cfcbc, branch SpExportaEcommerce) implements only these DMZ credit targets: getSms, validateSms, SendSmsNewNumber, codigoPromocion, getPlazos, GetCreditAmounts, guardardocumento, SaveImagesProductosMx, prospecto/recuperarcuenta, partner/client and order/new. It has no CreditoWeb_* routes and none of codigoRecomendado(+WithUen), Validar_Lada, ExistRFCAndPhoneCte, SaveHaztenTransaction, getCreditAccount, GetPhoneValidatedClientSecretName, prospecto/rfc, order/creditStatus, order/updateCreditOrderId or customerService/validarCoberturaPorCP.

Because Curl.Post and Get swallow every exception and return e.ToString() (Curl.cs:108-111, 259-262), and the controllers wrap that in Ok(), a missing route or a backend failure reaches Magento as HTTP 200 with exception text in the body.

gemini_corrections: Omnipro_MaviCredito is not a pure proxy with no SQL. On the Magento side it writes table omnipro_credito_sms (ResourceModel\SmsSolicitud.php:14; CreditoManagement.php:363-371, 394-415, 442-456) and customer attribute customer_temp_cash_account (CreditoManagement.php:422-426). Downstream, DMZ credit/getSms goes to LAN, which writes VTASDCodigoVerificacioneCommerce and TcAAEA00030_EnvioMensajes and runs UPDATE Cte.IDMagento (LAN CreditMethods.cs:2102-2196).
getUrlRegistro makes no DMZ call at all. It builds a redirect URL from config mavi_credito/registro_url plus serialized order and customer data (CreditoManagement.php:469-551).

getSms and validateSms in the DMZ are not a blind pass-through. The DMZ translates LAN codes: getSms '0' -> 400 'Error de credenciales', '1' -> 400 'Error de telefono', '3' -> 200 'Correcto'; validateSms '5' -> 200, '6' -> 400 (DMZ CreditController.cs:78-95, 109-123).

Mavi_CreditRequest getCreditRequest() does not fix UEN=1. It sends uen=1 for muebles_america and 2 otherwise (CreditRequest.php:62). The body {cliente_id, uen} matches DMZ customerService/obtenerCreditos (Models\CustomerServiceRequest.cs:58-62). It lists an existing client's credits; it does not save an opening request.

The opening request (APERTURA) is in Mavi\CreditMigration's guest flow, not in Omnipro_MaviCredito or CreditRequest. getRequestInfo with tipo APERTURA forces article AMER00100 and origen 'APERTURA CUENTA' (CredilanaManagement.php:84-93; Helper\Data.php:195-200). The save goes to DMZ CreditoWeb_SaveData (SP_CREDITO_WEB_DATOS).
open_questions: Magento core_config_data values for every endpoint path are not in code (mavi_cliente/creditmigration/general/url_*, mavi_checkout/productosmx/general/url_*, omnipro_intelisisintegration/mavi_credito/*, mavi_cliente/hazten/general/api_sync, url_prospect_tracking, url_credit_request, url_generar_rfc, url_recuperar_cuenta, url_new_client_validation). The Magento->DMZ mapping here rests on body shape. The user should run a read-only core_config_data query per environment.

The production DMZ Web.config is untracked (deleted from git in 2caa18c). On the share, URL_INTELISIS equals URL_SAP. Which host does URL_INTELISIS point to in QA and production? If it points to ServicioSAP, every CreditoWeb_* route, codigoRecomendado(+WithUen), ExistRFCAndPhoneCte, SaveHaztenTransaction, getCreditAccount, prospecto/rfc, order/creditStatus and order/updateCreditOrderId would 404, and the caller still gets HTTP 200 with the exception text (Curl.cs:108-111, 259-262).
Does the LAN accept the JWT issued by ServicioSAP? Curl.cs:84 sends TokenSAP to URL_INTELISIS (RC-03 in CONFIRMACIONES_PENDIENTES_2026-10-06.md:103).

Should ServicioSAP expose CreditoWeb_FormDatos, CreditoWeb_SaveFirstData, CreditoWeb_SaveData(_Articulos), CreditoWeb_Informacion and the other routes, or does the DMZ keep the LAN for the opening flow? Per memory, SP_CREDITO_WEB_DATOS migration scope is only @Op='Insert' inside order/new.
Hazten sync can lose data silently. SyncTransaction.php:50-52 marks sync=true on any HTTP 200, and the DMZ returns 200 even when the backend call failed. Confirm whether a fix is wanted.

Magento sends pruebaDeVida (CredilanaManagement.php:556-560), but the DMZ SaveImagesRequest model has no such property (Models\CreditRequest.cs:122-127), so the liveness image is dropped. Is that intended?

CredilanaManagement::getCreditAmounts hard-codes tipo='CREDITO' (CredilanaManagement.php:69), so apertura amounts (montos_cte_nuevo_apertura) are never returned through /V1/credito/getCreditAmounts. Is the Vue frontend expected to use another path?

codigoPromocion: the LAN uses SpVTASVentaCupon (CreditMethods.cs:403) and ServicioSAP uses SpVentasCupones on SIGMavi (CreditMethods.cs:30). The DMZ still routes this call to the LAN (DMZ CreditController.cs:135). Same SP renamed, or a different SP?

The ServicioSAP authorization callback is commented out (OrderMethods.cs:673-707), and its payload is snake_case {entity_id, status, customer_account, credit_request_id} (:1257-1263), which does not bind to the DMZ CreditAuthorizationRequest {entityId, status, cuenta, idSolicitud} (Models\CreditRequest.cs:212-218). Who sets omnipro_credito_pending.id_solicitud under SAP?
DMZ credit/guardardocumento is [AllowAnonymous] (CreditController.cs:448) and writes MAVI_DOC_CTE through ServicioSAP. Is that exposure intended?
Logging of sensitive data: DMZ Logger.Credit writes full payloads, including base64 ID images (CreditController.cs:214) and NIP/SMS requests (:71, :102).
LAN Conn\Connection.cs:26-35 and the LAN Web.config USER_DMZ hold plaintext credentials in source (values not repeated here).
No Magento PHP caller of credit/Validar_Lada was found. Is it called from the Vue Storefront frontend?

The bodies of SpCREDISolicitudWebPrimerGuardado, SPCREDICredilana, SP_CREDITO_WEB_VALORES_FORM and SpCREDICredilanaSeguroDeVida are not in C#. Which tables they read and write must come from SPsOrden / SqlQuerys (other tracers).

wrong.correction: It does not. saveRequestNoBiometric never calls _biometricManagement->saveTempTransaction or validation, so no mavi_hazten_credit_transaction row is created. wrong.claim: A missing route or a backend failure reaches Magento as HTTP 200 with the exception text in the body (stated as general, for every route).
wrong.correction: That holds only for actions that wrap the curl result in Ok() or Json(). getSms and validateSms map any unexpected text to 400 (default branch). GetPhoneValidatedClientSecretName and customerService/validarCoberturaPorCP run JsonConvert.DeserializeObject on the exception text, which throws and gives a 500. A ServicioSAP login failure in the Curl constructor rethrows, so the caller gets a 500 on every route. PostSAP and GetSAP return a 'WebException: ... Body: ...' string, not e.ToString(). Minor: Curl.Get's catch is at 258-261, not 259-262.

wrong.claim: ServicioSAP implements only these DMZ credit targets: getSms, validateSms, SendSmsNewNumber, codigoPromocion, getPlazos, GetCreditAmounts, guardardocumento, SaveImagesProductosMx, prospecto/recuperarcuenta, partner/client and order/new.

wrong.correction: The connection is sCadenaConexion (MAVICUBOS / IntelisisTmp). For op Elimina, the SP UPDATEs Cupon and re-runs itself with 'NUEVO', which INSERTs into VTASCVentaCupon. ValidarCupon reads VTASCVentaCupon, Comercializadora.dbo.Personal, TablaStD and Agente.

wrong.claim: Step 12 / endpoints: prospecto/rfc is part of APERTURA ('RFC helper').
wrong.correction: This is not proven, and the code points the other way. The opening flow builds the RFC inside Magento with Mavi\ProductosMX\Model\RFC::obtenerRFC, a pure PHP algorithm with no HTTP call, during guest/sendRequest. No PHP caller of /V1/prospecto/rfc was found inside the CreditMigration flow. It should be labelled 'other / possibly the Vue frontend'.
wrong.evidence: Magento Mavi\CreditMigration\Model\CredilanaManagement.php:21,48,395-406; Mavi\ProductosMX\Model\RFC.php:11-123 (only string functions, no adapter or curl).

wrong.claim: Step 11 (prospect -> client cron): tables list only CREDIHProspectoACliente.
wrong.correction: The cron is driven by the Magento table mavi_hazten_credit_transaction. It reads rows with is_c_account=false and updated_at within the last week, and writes is_c_account=1 and c_account by request_id. Two consequences: a prospect that converts after more than a week is never tracked, and no-biometric requests are never tracked.

missing.what: APERTURA vs CREDITO branch values in the final save (Insert_2): when origen is not 'CREDILANA MX' (APERTURA CUENTA), condicion is forced to '12 M MA P INM' (uen 1) or '12 M VIU P INM' (uen 2). Otherwise it is the condition the client chose. Sucursal is 504 (MA) or 505 (VIU). Estatus is '7' on Insert_2 and '8' on Update. data[64] is the sha1 uid used as the image code.

A failed SP_CREDITO_WEB_DATOS Insert is reported as success. If the SP returns no row, the LAN sets res='0' and still returns '0/<prospect>'. Magento's is_numeric('0') check passes, so the flow continues with request id 0: SaveIdDatosTemp with 0, Update WHERE id=0, coupon 'PW0', and a Hazten request_id of 0.

Hazten biometrics go directly from Magento to the Hazten API, not through the DMZ, at every screen step. The calls are: create the transaction (getRequestInfo), PUT updates in setData and setAddress, the Magento webapi /V1/credit/biometric/uploadImages and getLivenessStatus (upload URL, PUT of the image to an AWS presigned URL, OCR extract), and validation plus /process at the end. verify.confidence: High for the DMZ routing, the Curl behavior, the Web.config observation (URL_INTELISIS == URL_SAP, a loopback URL; values not printed) and the corrections above, all of which I re-read in code and SP sources. Most of T3's file:line citations checked out, including the DMZ route lines, the LAN controllers, the CreditMethods anchors, the Connection.cs fields, the PollCreditStatus URL building and the cited vault doc lines.

title: LAN code of the opening routes

result.summary:
T4 traced the LAN code behind every credit and prospect route in \\172.16.214.58\sap\LAN\WebApiMagento (branch stage-delta, HEAD 68b2290, 2026-08-24) that the opening process can reach. LAN never calls an SMS provider, the credit bureau, Hazten, AWS or SEPOMEX directly. Its only outbound HTTP goes to (a) the Liberador service (Web.config keys AUTENTICACION_URL_LIBERADOR, VETA_URL_LIBERADOR, CREDILANA_URL_LIBERADOR, PASSWORD_AUTENTICACION_LIBERADOR; host 172.16.215.51:3026) and (b) the DMZ, for the authorization callback (URL_DMZ, USER_DMZ). SMS is queued by INSERT into ServicioAndroid.dbo.TcAAEA00030_EnvioMensajes, and an external sender (SpAAea00030_ArmadoSMS, per the SP comment) delivers it. All SQL connections are hardcoded fields in Conn\Connection.cs:26-35, not Web.config connectionStrings: sCadenaConexion = MAVICUBOS.grupomavi.com/IntelisisTmp; sCadenaConexionAndriod = mavicbosandroid.grupomavi.com/ServicioAndroid; sCadenaConexionAdminDoc = same host/AdminDoc; sCadenaConexionSigMavi = same host/SIGMAVI; sCadenaComercializadora = MAVICUBOS/Comercializadora. A SQLite file, C:\inetpub\wwwroot\api\data.db, caches the catalogs (table mavi_credilana_info).

New-customer OPENING ("APERTURA CUENTA", Mavi\CreditMigration) on LAN works like this:
- Catalogs: credit/CreditoWeb_FormDatos (SQLite or SP_CREDITO_WEB_VALORES_FORM) and credit/CreditoWeb_Informacion (SPCREDICredilana).
- First-save, SMS and NIP: credit/CreditoWeb_SaveFirstData runs SpCREDISolicitudWebPrimerGuardado. That writes CREDIDSolicitudWebDatosPrimerGuardado, CREDIHSolicitudWebHistoricoNip and TcAAea00030_EnvioMensajes (IdMensaje 14).
- RFC: prospecto/rfc runs spRegistroSugerir.
- Referral code: credit/codigoRecomendado* reads CREDIDCodigoRecomendador.
- Duplicate check: credit/ExistRFCAndPhoneCte is a no-op because of an early return.
- Main save: credit/CreditoWeb_SaveData, op Insert_2 then Update. It runs CredyPrestamoMethods.CreditoWeb_SaveData. First, cte_prospecto runs SP_GeneraConsecutivoCteMavi, which writes IntelisisTmp.dbo.TempCteDOS and returns a P######## prospect number. Then SP_CREDITO_WEB_DATOS inserts ServicioAndroid.dbo.CRED_SOLICITUD_WEB_DATOS_TEMP with estatus 7 (8 on Update). Then TrWACW00041_RefSolCredWeb gets the references.
- Biometrics: credit/SaveHaztenTransaction (Magento cron) writes SIGMAVI.CREDIHBiometrico, CREDIDEtapaProcesamiento and CREDIDTransaccionMetaDato, plus IntelisisTmp.RM0855ACoordenadasProspecto.
- Prospect to client: credit/getCreditAccount (Magento ProspectTracking cron) reads IntelisisTmp.CREDIHProspectoACliente.

Key finding: on the APERTURA path LAN does NOT call the Liberador, does NOT create a Venta, and does NOT notify anyone. The request is left in CRED_SOLICITUD_WEB_DATOS_TEMP for a process outside these repos. The Liberador runs only (1) for existing C-accounts in the credit checkout (order/setOrder, then OrderMethods.SetPedido, then ProductosCreditoWeb_SaveData, then LiberadorCreditoMethods /api/venta, then CallMagentoAuthorizationCallback to DMZ order/authorizationResult) and (2) for Credilana (CreditoWeb_Seguro op Solicitud, then Liberador /api/credilana).

ProductosMX opening uses credit/CreditoWeb_SaveData_Articulos: Credit.Methods.CreditoWeb_SaveData plus SpVTASInsertArtSolCreditoLinea, which writes MAVIANDROID01.ServicioAndroid.dbo.VTASdArtCreditoWeb over a linked server.

In the DMZ ConexionSAP branch (HEAD 09cb341), these LAN routes are NOT reached because the DMZ sends them to ServicioSAP: GetCreditAmounts, SaveImagesProductosMx, SendSmsNewNumber, recuperarcuenta, guardardocumento, getPlazos, getClienteFactura.

Bugs found in LAN:
- checkSaldo always returns 0.
- Every Update consumes a prospect number.
- Reference-3 lada is read from the wrong index.
- Latitude and longitude are swapped in the coordinates insert.
- The leyenda cache branch is dead.
- The Credilana customer-service phone is cached under uen=0 but read with uen 1/2.
- SQL injection through string.Format in several queries.
- Plaintext credentials in Connection.cs.

gemini_corrections: Gemini says Omnipro_MaviCredito getSms/validateSms are a pure REST proxy with no SQL. That is only true for Magento and the DMZ. The LAN target does SQL: credit/getSms writes IntelisisTmp.Cte.IDMagento (CreditMethods.cs:2196), ServicioAndroid.VTASDCodigoVerificacioneCommerce (:2077, :2147) and TcAAEA00030_EnvioMensajes (:2250), and reads CteTel (:2229). credit/validateSms runs SPVTASCodigoSeguridadeCommerce op CODIGO (:59).

Gemini omits that the NIP is no longer validated in LAN getSms: NipRequest (Models\CreditRequest.cs:8-13) carries no NIP, and ProductosCredito_Nip (CreditMethods.cs:21-48) only sends a code to the validated phone. The legacy SP op NIP that checked Cte.NIPVenta is no longer called.

Gemini omits the opening save. On LAN it is credit/CreditoWeb_SaveData (Insert_2 then Update): it creates the prospect with SP_GeneraConsecutivoCteMavi/TempCteDOS and the request with SP_CREDITO_WEB_DATOS in ServicioAndroid.CRED_SOLICITUD_WEB_DATOS_TEMP, and it does NOT call the Liberador or create a Venta.

Gemini omits the SMS for the opening: it does not come from getSms but from SpCREDISolicitudWebPrimerGuardado op SaveNip (IdMensaje 14, Cliente 'CW00001') through credit/CreditoWeb_SaveFirstData. The opening has no external SMS provider call either: SMS is a DB queue.

Gemini says Mavi_CreditRequest getCreditRequest() sets UEN=1 and sends the payload to the ERP. In LAN, sucursal 504/505 and the APERTURA conditions are hardcoded by UEN (CredilanaManagement.php:431-435; CredyPrestamoMethods.cs:339-341), and the 'ERP' is ServicioAndroid.CRED_SOLICITUD_WEB_DATOS_TEMP, not Intelisis Venta. T4 did not verify Mavi_CreditRequest itself.

LAN never calls the Liberador for prospects (the Liberador runs only when cliente starts with 'C': CreditMethods.cs:208, or for Credilana: CredyPrestamoMethods.cs:574-575). It is called at :198 (setClientData), :397 (saveRequest) and :603 (saveRequestNoBiometric). LAN prospecto/rfc -> spRegistroSugerir is reached only through the separate webapi Mavi\GenerarRFC /V1/prospecto/rfc (GenerateRFC.php:83-91, config url_generar_rfc :119-122). wrong.correction: Mavi\WalletUnification\Plugin\OrderManagement.php:69,92 calls its own Helper\Data::getCreditAccount(int $customerId), and that only reads the Magento customer attribute customer_temp_cash_account (WalletUnification\Helper\Data.php:101-104). wrong.correction: The full core_config_data paths are mavi_cliente/creditmigration/general/<key> for CreditMigration (Helper\Data.php:13) and mavi_checkout/productosmx/general/<key> for ProductosMX (ProductosMX\Helper\Data.php:20). Use these when asking the user for the configured values.

For each converted account it POSTs a Google Analytics Measurement Protocol event 'Credilana Nuevo Funnel / Paso 9 - Confirmacion Exitosa' (:87-136; config measurement_id/api_secret). It then sets is_c_account=1 and c_account (:66-79). missing.evidence: CreditMethods.cs:2392-2396 dereferences LivenessTests.FirstOrDefault(Status=='SUCCEEDED') without a null check, so a transaction without a succeeded liveness test throws, the route returns 500, and the cron retries every run (SyncTransaction.php:50 skips marking sync). SaveCoordsInNewTable runs first, outside any transaction (:2304,:2306), so every retry inserts duplicate RM0855ACoordenadasProspecto rows. Conversely, when the INSERT returns DBNull the method returns false with HTTP 200, and the cron marks the row synced.

The code is stored in CRED_SOLICITUD_WEB_DATOS_TEMP.CodigoRecomendador (CredyPrestamoMethods.cs:102; SP :272,333). Redemption and the referrer SMS live in SpCREDICodigoRecomendador (vault SPsOrden\SpCREDICodigoRecomendador.sql; opcion 2 :91-128 writes CREDIDCodigoRecomendador and MAVIANDROID01.ServicioAndroid.dbo.TcAAea00030_EnvioMensajes). T4 did not mention this SP, although its source is in the vault.

missing.evidence: CreditMigration sends {uen, codRecom} (CredilanaManagement.php:407-410, 613-616, 895-900), which matches the CodigoRecomendadoWithUen model. ProductosMX sends only {codRecom} (CreditMxManagement.php:151), which matches the string.Format route codigoRecomendado (CreditMethods.cs:1117-1119). The actual routes depend on the url_codigo_recomendador config values.

missing.what: Gemini lead on Omnipro_MaviCredito: getUrlRegistro and validateUser are not pure DMZ proxies.
missing.evidence: getUrlRegistro (Omnipro\MaviCredito\Model\CreditoManagement.php:469-551) makes no DMZ call. It loads the Magento order and builds a querystring URL to an external registration form (config getUrlRegistro) with PHP serialize() of the items and of customer PII. validateUser (:345-378) calls the same getSms endpoint (LAN credit/getSms). It also writes the Magento SmsSolicitud table and the customer attribute customer_temp_cash_account (:363-374, :422-427).

missing.what: Minor LAN behaviours on opening routes that T4 omitted.
missing.evidence: (1) ProductosCredito_Clave returns e.Message to the caller on any exception, which can leak DB error text to Magento (CreditMethods.cs:87-90). (2) checkSaldo runs the SP twice (ExecuteScalar at :788 and :790). (3) If SP_CREDITO_WEB_DATOS Insert fails, res becomes '0' but the reference insert still does int.Parse("") and throws a 500 after a P-number was already consumed (CredyPrestamoMethods.cs:125-141). (4) The Update background Task.Run has no try/catch or logging, so failures after the 10 s delay are silent (CreditController.cs:409-416).

verify.confidence: High for the corrections. Each one comes from re-reading the cited code: the LAN repo (stage-delta, HEAD 68b2290), DMZ (ConexionSAP, HEAD 09cb341), the Magento248 modules CreditMigration / ProductosMX / Hazten / ProspectTracking / WalletUnification / GenerarRFC / Omnipro MaviCredito, and the vault SP sources. Most of T4's claims hold up: the LAN SaveData flow, the SP and table names, the SpCREDISolicitudWebPrimerGuardado ops and lines, the dead ExistRFCAndPhoneCte, the lat/long swap, the ref-3 lada index bug, the uen=0 vs uen 1/2 cache mismatch for the Credilana phone, req.Equals(string), checkSaldo always 0, the DMZ routing, the hardcoded Connection.cs fields, and that the Liberador runs only for 'C' accounts and Credilana. Medium confidence on the ProductosMX data[14] overwrite: the code is unambiguous, but intent cannot be confirmed without the user. Not verified: OrderMethods line-level details in T4's step 14, and the Liberador host IP (its value lives in Web.config and was not printed).

title: Stored procedures and tables deep dive

result.summary:
The SQL behind the credit-opening flow (APERTURA CUENTA and the related PRODUCTOS MX / CREDILANA MX paths) sits almost entirely in LAN (WebApiMagento, branch stage-delta). It runs on 2 SQL servers that call each other through linked servers. (1) ServicioAndroid on mavicbosandroid.grupomavi.com (LAN key sCadenaConexionAndriod). It holds the web request: CRED_SOLICITUD_WEB_DATOS_TEMP, TrWACW00041_RefSolCredWeb, VTASdArtCreditoWeb, the pre-request CREDIDSolicitudWebDatosPrimerGuardado, CREDIDRefPrimerGuardadoCredWeb and CREDIHSolicitudWebHistoricoNip, plus the SMS queue TcAAEA00030_EnvioMensajes and VTASDCodigoVerificacioneCommerce. (2) IntelisisTmp on MAVICUBOS.grupomavi.com (key sCadenaConexion). It holds Cte, CteTel, CteEnviarA, TablaStD, prices (PropreListaDFinal, VTASCCondicionesCredVtaLinea), TempCteDOS (the prospect counter), coupons and referral codes. SP_CREDITO_WEB_DATOS lives in ServicioAndroid and reads Intelisis through ERPMAVI.IntelisisTmp.dbo.*. SpVTASInsertArtSolCreditoLinea lives in IntelisisTmp and writes back to ServicioAndroid through MAVIANDROID01.ServicioAndroid.dbo.VTASdArtCreditoWeb. Other stores: AdminDoc.MAVI_DOC_CTE (documents), SIGMAVI (Hazten biometrics), the LAN SQLite file C:\inetpub\wwwroot\api\data.db (catalog/amount cache) and Magento MySQL tables.

Opening sequence at DB level:
- Pre-request (SpCREDISolicitudWebPrimerGuardado ops SaveFirstData, UpdateFirstData, UpdateFirstDom, SaveRef, SaveNip, ValNip, SaveIdDatosTemp).
- RFC calculation (spRegistroSugerir and its helper SPs).
- Area code, referral code and coupon checks (inline SQL and SpVTASVentaCupon).
- Prospect number: SP_GeneraConsecutivoCteMavi writes 'P'+8 digits to TempCteDOS.
- Formal request: SP_CREDITO_WEB_DATOS @Op='Insert' (estatus 7), references by inline INSERT, product lines through SpVTASInsertArtSolCreditoLinea (ProductosMX only).
- Async @Op='Update' after 10 s (estatus 8, image codes, card and loan flags).
- Images to MAVI_DOC_CTE and disk.
- Hazten biometrics to SIGMAVI plus RM0855ACoordenadasProspecto.
- After the save, no code in any repo moves the request forward. Intelisis does the analysis outside these repos, and LAN only reads the results: Venta 'Solicitud Credito' / 'Analisis Credito' / 'Pedido' and CREDIHProspectoACliente (prospect to client), polled by Magento crons.

All 10 opening-flow SPs with source in the vault were read: SP_CREDITO_WEB_DATOS, SpCREDISolicitudWebPrimerGuardado, SpVTASInsertArtSolCreditoLinea, SP_GeneraConsecutivoCteMavi, spRegistroSugerir (and helpers), SpVTASVentaCupon, SpCREDICodigoRecomendador, SpCREDIDatosSolicitudCreditoArt, SPVTASCodigoSeguridadeCommerce, SP_eCommerceCtenuevo. No source in the vault or anywhere on the share: SP_CREDITO_WEB_VALORES_FORM, SPCREDICredilana, SpCREDICredilanaSeguroDeVida, FnVTASListaCredilanas, FNVTASValidarEmpleado, FnVTASMuestraCuatro, SpAAea00030_ArmadoSMS (the SMS dispatcher), the nested xpVerCosto/spMoneda/spArtUnidadFactor/spUnidadFactor, fnSplitV2, and a ServicioAndroid copy of SpCREDIDatosSolicitudCreditoArt.

Corrections to the vault's ANALISIS_SP_CREDITO_WEB_DATOS.md:
- SP_GeneraConsecutivoCteMavi is NOT orphaned. The C# calls it (Credit/Methods.cs:260, CredyPrestamoMethods.cs:215). It is how every APERTURA/ProductosMX/Credilana prospect number is made, and the CreditMigration path burns an extra number on every Update.
- @Op='Update' IS reachable. Magento sends it (CredilanaManagement.php:572,:778; CreditMxManagement.php:513) and LAN runs it fire-and-forget (CreditController.cs:217-224, :409-416). Only Insert is in the migration scope, but the process uses both.

New defects found:
- ProductosMX overwrites the postal code (data[14]) with the promoter code (CreditMxManagement.php:427 vs :454). The wrong value reaches @codigo_postal and @Cp.
- LAN never passes @ClaveMensaje to SpCREDISolicitudWebPrimerGuardado, so SMS rows get Clave NULL.
- The NIP is stored in clear text in CREDIHSolicitudWebHistoricoNip.
- The existing-customer checkout check is broken by the GetSaldo defect and a connection mismatch.
- getSms no longer checks Cte.NIPVenta.
- codigoRecomendado runs SQL built with string.Format (injectable).
- ServicioSAP's mavi_credilana_info SQLite cache has no code that writes to it.
- ServicioSAP's port of SpVTASInsertArtSolCreditoLinea leaves cost NULL and drops the TELEFONIA region swap.

gemini_corrections: Gemini: 'Omnipro_MaviCredito getSms/validateSms are a pure REST proxy with no SQL'. True only for the Magento layer. The LAN target writes SQL. credit/getSms (LAN CreditMethods.cs:21-48, :2102-2189) UPDATEs IntelisisTmp Cte.IDMagento (:2196) and INSERTs ServicioAndroid VTASDCodigoVerificacioneCommerce (:2076-2079) and TcAAEA00030_EnvioMensajes (:2250-2251). credit/validateSms runs SPVTASCodigoSeguridadeCommerce @Op='CODIGO' (CreditMethods.cs:57-80).

Gemini skipped the DB layer of the opening itself. APERTURA (Mavi\CreditMigration) does NOT go through Omnipro or CreditRequest for persistence. It uses credit/CreditoWeb_SaveFirstData, which runs SpCREDISolicitudWebPrimerGuardado. Then credit/CreditoWeb_SaveData runs SP_GeneraConsecutivoCteMavi, then SP_CREDITO_WEB_DATOS Insert and Update, plus TrWACW00041_RefSolCredWeb. The chain is CredilanaManagement.php:90-97, :510, :572 to LAN CredyPrestamoMethods.cs:29-210.

Vault correction (ANALISIS_SP_CREDITO_WEB_DATOS.md §7): SP_GeneraConsecutivoCteMavi is not orphaned. LAN runs it from C# with 'exec SP_GeneraConsecutivoCteMavi 'MAVI'' at Credit\Methods.cs:260 and CredyPrestamoMethods.cs:215. It generates every APERTURA/ProductosMX/Credilana prospect number. The earlier grep only searched the SPsOrden folder.

Vault correction (ANALISIS §10.5 and the 'only Insert' claim): @Op='Update' IS sent. Magento sends it at CredilanaManagement.php:572, :778 and CreditMxManagement.php:513. LAN runs it at CreditController.cs:217-224 and :409-416.

Vault (ANALISIS §6) GetSaldo defect confirmed. One addition: LAN calls SpCREDIDatosSolicitudCreditoArt on two different databases. CheckCliente and GetInfo go to IntelisisTmp (CreditMethods.cs:730, :812). GetSaldo goes to ServicioAndroid (:772), where the vault has no source.

Where are the Magento admin URLs configured (mavi_cliente/creditmigration/general/url_* and mavi_checkout/productosmx/general/url_*)? They live in core_config_data, not in code, so the DMZ route each one hits must be confirmed from the database or admin.
Who calls LAN credit/SaveCredilanaInfo to refresh the SQLite cache? And how is ServicioSAP's own mavi_credilana_info (SQLITE_DB_PATH) populated? No writer exists in ServicioSAP.

title: After the request: analysis, liberador, prospect to client, notifications; and ServicioSAP coverage

result.summary:
After a credit request is saved, two different post-processing chains run, and the code keeps them separate.

(A) Checkout credit purchase (payment method omnipro_pago_credito, "CRED<quoteId>").
- Magento keeps the quote in omnipro_credito_pending.
- In LAN, a background thread calls the external Liberador (POST VETA_URL_LIBERADOR), but only for C accounts. It then calls back DMZ order/authorizationResult, which goes on to Magento /V1/omnipro-credito/authorizationResult.
- The credit area analyses the request inside Intelisis, through the Venta chain 'Solicitud Credito' -> 'Analisis Credito' -> 'Pedido' -> 'Factura'.
- Every 5 minutes a Magento cron polls DMZ order/creditStatus, which goes to LAN and reads Venta. On AUTORIZADO the cron places the Magento order and calls order/updateCreditOrderId, which renames Venta.IdEcommerce and eCommerceDetPedidos from CRED to the real increment id.
- Another cron tracks invoicing through order/GetIntelisisStatuses (Venta 'Factura%') and fires the shipment email and the invoice webhook.

(B) Account opening (APERTURA "Credito Muebles America" in Mavi_CreditMigration, and ProductosMX).
- LAN creates a prospect P+8 digits with SP_GeneraConsecutivoCteMavi, then writes CRED_SOLICITUD_WEB_DATOS_TEMP (estatus 7, then 8) plus the reference rows.
- No liberador runs for prospects.
- The Hazten cron pushes the biometrics to LAN SaveHaztenTransaction, which writes SIGMAVI CREDIH*/CREDID* and RM0855ACoordenadasProspecto.
- Intelisis (no repo writer) later fills CREDIHProspectoACliente when the P account becomes a C account.
- An hourly Magento cron, Mavi_ProspectTracking, polls DMZ credit/getCreditAccount/{P}, which goes to LAN. On a match it only sends a GA4 event ("Credilana Nuevo Funnel / Paso 9") and marks mavi_hazten_credit_transaction.is_c_account. It does not update the Magento customer.

No code anywhere sends the customer an SMS or email about the credit decision. Order-history comments are written with notify=false.

ServicioSAP (c1cfcbc) coverage of the post-request steps:
- The request insert exists: order/new credit branch, OrderMethods.cs:1797-1820 -> CRED_SOLICITUD_WEB_DATOS_TEMP.
- The liberador trigger is commented out (OrderMethods.cs:673-707, BLOCKED DU11). The callback method is dead and sends snake_case keys (OrderMethods.cs:1257-1263) while the DMZ expects camelCase.
- creditStatus is missing. The only building block is MovBita (movbita/events/{vbeln} -> AI_GET_ZSDT_MOVBITA, option E of DEC-32).
- updateCreditOrderId is missing (DU20).
- GetIntelisisStatuses is missing (C-16).
- getCreditAccount is missing (R9-13).
- SaveHaztenTransaction and all CreditoWeb_* opening routes are missing (G12, R9-10/R9-15, DEC-22, CX-27 tag).
- obtenerCreditos exists in ServicioSAP but the DMZ does not route to it.

Net effect if the DMZ ships as on ConexionSAP: every checkout credit order stays PENDIENTE in Magento forever. The poller only reads rows that are EN_ANALISIS with an id_solicitud, and only the callback that is now commented out moves a row there.

gemini_corrections: Omnipro_MaviCredito getUrlRegistro does not call the DMZ through the Adapter. It builds the external form URL locally from config, putting PHP-serialized personal data (phone, names, email, address, birth date) in the query string (CreditoManagement.php:469-552). The form returns to /mavicredito/webhook/result, which sets credit_payment_review (Result.php:75-139).
Omnipro_MaviCredito is not a pure proxy. It declares a db_schema (SmsSolicitud) and runs a cron (CancelOrders.php:42-68) that cancels credit orders in Magento.

Mavi_CreditRequest getCreditRequest does not hard-code UEN=1. It sends uen=1 only for store 'muebles_america' and 2 otherwise (CreditRequest.php:62). It does not submit a request: it reads the customer's credits ({cliente_id, uen}, :68-75). That payload matches DMZ ObtenerCreditosRequest, i.e. customerService/obtenerCreditos (CustomerServiceRequest.cs:57-61).

The summary skipped the whole post-request chain: authorizationResult (CreditoOrderManagement.php:84-207), PollCreditStatus with creditStatus and updateCreditOrderId, InvoiceDataAnalysis (GetIntelisisStatuses), the Hazten SyncTransaction cron, ProspectTracking (getCreditAccount plus GA4), and CancelOrders.

wrong.claim: The DMZ post-request routes (order/creditStatus, order/updateCreditOrderId, order/GetIntelisisStatuses, credit/getCreditAccount, credit/SaveHaztenTransaction, credit/CreditoWeb_SaveData, customerService/obtenerCreditos) forward to LAN through curl.Get/Post to URL_INTELISIS.
wrong.correction: That is what the code says. On the checked-in ConexionSAP branch, though, the active URL_INTELISIS and URL_SAP point to the same host and port (the production-like values are commented out). The Curl constructor also no longer logs in to LAN: it reuses the ServicioSAP token (Token = TokenSAP). As committed, these "LAN" calls reach the ServicioSAP host, where none of the routes exist except customerService/obtenerCreditos. They reach LAN only if production config restores a separate URL_INTELISIS. Even then they carry the ServicioSAP token, which LAN accepts only because the JWT_* appSettings are identical in the LAN and SS Web.config files.

wrong.claim: No code anywhere sends the customer an SMS or email about the credit decision.
wrong.correction: Overstated (PLAUSIBLE; Magento core is not on the share, so this rests on standard 2.4 behaviour). PollCreditStatus and authorizationResult create the order through CartManagementInterface::placeOrder. In core that fires the standard new-order confirmation email unless sales_email/order is disabled, and no credit module suppresses it. That email is in practice the approval notice. CancelOrders adds its comment through OrderManagementInterface::addComment with is_customer_notified=true, and core OrderService::addComment then sends the order-comment email. What is true is that no custom SMS or email for the decision exists.
wrong.evidence: PollCreditStatus.php:178. CreditoOrderManagement.php:160. CancelOrders.php:70-79 (setIsCustomerNotified(true), orderManagement->addComment). A grep for OrderSender/CanSendNewEmail in Omnipro/MaviCredito and Mavi/CreditoCheckout finds nothing. Mavi/FixEmailSender/Plugin/OrderSenderPlugin.php:17-24 only sets customer_is_guest and does not suppress sending.

wrong.claim: A7: CancelOrders writes a comment with is_customer_notified=true, but no email is sent by this code.
wrong.correction: It goes through Magento OrderManagementInterface::addComment, which in core sends the comment email when is_customer_notified is true. The customer probably gets the cancellation message by email (PLAUSIBLE, core not on the share).

wrong.claim: Order-history comments are written with notify=false (PollCreditStatus.php:211-215; CreditoOrderManagement.php:165-168).
wrong.correction: addCommentToStatusHistory($comment, $status, $isVisibleOnFront) has no notify argument. CreditoOrderManagement passes status=false and visibleOnFront=false. PollCreditStatus passes status='processing' and visibleOnFront=false. The comments are hidden from the storefront; that does not make them a notification switch.

wrong.claim: A3 presents the callback's AUTORIZADO branch (reactivate quote, placeOrder, registerOrder) as a live way to authorize a checkout credit.
wrong.correction: In LAN that branch can never be reached. LiberadorCreditoMethods.LiberarCliente only returns EN_ANALISIS (idVenta>0 or idVenta=0) or RECHAZADO (exception), never AUTORIZADO. Only PollCreditStatus places authorized credit orders, and it does not call registerOrder. That makes the two paths behave differently: only the callback path would re-sync the order.

In those cases no liberador thread starts and no callback is sent, so the omnipro_credito_pending row stays PENDIENTE and the poller never reads it.
