wrong.claim: B2: on HTTP 200 SyncTransaction sets sync=1, i.e. the biometrics were saved.
wrong.correction: A 200 does not prove LAN saved anything. DMZ Curl.Post catches every exception and returns e.ToString() as the body. DMZ SaveHaztenTransaction wraps that in Json(...) with HTTP 200. Magento therefore marks sync=1 even when LAN (or the SS host the active config points to) failed, and the row is never retried.

missing.what: Security: the Magento REST routes /V1/omnipro-credito/authorizationResult and /V1/omnipro-credito/requestCreditOrder use resource ref="anonymous". Anyone who can reach Magento can POST status=AUTORIZADO for a quote id still in PENDIENTE and get a processing credit order placed without the DMZ, LAN or the liberador. TOKEN_MAGENTO in the DMZ is decorative. di.xml also disables accessChangeQuoteControl globally so placeOrder works outside a customer context.

A DEV bypass in the post-request chain: when auto_authorize_dev is enabled, requestCreditOrder skips the back end entirely, inserts omnipro_credito_pending status DEV_AUTO / credit_increment_id DEV-<quote>, and places a processing order at once.

Possible duplicate re-submission of authorized credit orders (PLAUSIBLE, depends on config omnipro_intelisisintegration/order/setorder_cron). PollCreditStatus creates the order but never sets synced. The Omnipro PlaceOrder Registry cron re-sends every order with synced 0/null through registerOrder to DMZ setOrder. The sales_order_save_after observer skips credit orders; this cron does not. In LAN, a credit-method order re-enters the credit branch and inserts another SP_CREDITO_WEB_DATOS request, plus another liberador call for C accounts. In SS, order/new inserts another CRED_SOLICITUD_WEB_DATOS_TEMP row. authorizationResult already handles a callback whose entityId is an order id, which suggests this has happened.
missing.evidence: Omnipro/PlaceOrder/etc/crontab.xml (omnipro_placeorder_order_registry); Model/OrderManagement.php:226-239, :991-998, :324-337, :611-613; Observer/PlaceOrderObserver.php:31-39; LAN OrderMethods.cs:609-649; SS OrderMethods.cs:1797-1820; CreditoOrderManagement.php:102-123

missing.what: The idSolicitud key space does not match in LAN GetCreditStatus. When the liberador returns idVenta=0, the callback stores the Android CRED_SOLICITUD id in id_solicitud, but GetCreditStatus looks it up as Venta.ID with Mov='Solicitud Credito'. That gives EN_ANALISIS forever or matches an unrelated Venta. When idVenta>0, the liberador comment says it is the Pedido id, yet step 1 requires Mov='Solicitud Credito' for that ID. GetCreditStatus also returns AUTORIZADO for any non-cancelled Pedido whose Situacion is not 'Rechazado'; it does not wait for Situacion='Liberado', contrary to the liberador comment.
missing.evidence: LAN CreditMethods.cs:225 and :235; LiberadorCreditoMethods.cs:76-93 (comment :78-80); OrderMethods.cs:1876-1892 and :1965-1986

missing.what: A second LAN place that renames the CRED id: SetPedido calls UpdateIdEcommerceEnVenta when a CRED-prefixed IdEcommerce is re-sent with a real increment id. This is separate from the updateCreditOrderId route. SS deleted it (comment at SS OrderMethods.cs:1381).

APERTURA no-biometric branch: saveRequestNoBiometric never calls saveTempTransaction. Those prospects get no mavi_hazten_credit_transaction row, so neither the Hazten sync (B2) nor ProspectTracking (B4) ever covers them. If LAN returns no prospect account (result[1] empty), the Update to estatus 8 and the image upload (saveNextFormData) are skipped too, leaving the request at estatus 7. saveRequest also hard-codes store_id as uen==1 ? 5 : 1.

Failure modes in the Hazten sync cron. There is no try/catch around the per-row loop, so one failing Hazten GET or a missing api_sync config ('URL LAN is required') aborts the whole run and blocks every later row. In LAN SaveHaztenTransaction, SaveCoordsInNewTable is called with longitude and latitude swapped against its (id, latitude, longitude) signature, so RM0855ACoordenadasProspecto.COORDENADAS is stored reversed. ExecuteScalar().ToString() throws a NullReferenceException when no CRED_SOLICITUD_WEB_DATOS_TEMP row exists, because the null check comes after ToString. Two coordinate rows are inserted per call, with no transaction across the SIGMAVI and IntelisisTmp inserts.

More ProspectTracking defects. sendAnalytics passes the row's store_id as the website id to website-scope getters. getMeasurementId, getApiSecret and getGoogleBaseUrl declare a string return, so a null config raises a TypeError, which catch(\Exception) in the cron does not catch, aborting the run. getCreditAccount catches only Magento\Setup\Exception, so adapter or JSON errors escape too.

InvoiceDataAnalysis queue cleanup is dead code: getNewOrderIncrementIds (delete rows older than 30 days) is never called. Rows never invoiced in Intelisis stay in mavi_invoice_new_orders and are re-queried on every run. That includes ProductosMX requests registered through mavi_new_credit_request and rejected credits.

After AUTORIZADO, CreditoOrderManagement::authorizationResult calls registerOrder, which re-syncs the order to DMZ setOrder. In registerOrder, setCAccount writes the account from the setOrder response body into customer_credit_account / is_customer_cash_account. B5 lists setCAccount but not that the authorization path triggers it, nor that the poller path does not.

The SaveOrder plugin on Magento\Sales\Model\Order runs on every credit order save, including the placeOrder after authorization. It blocks employees through Monedero phoneValidateSecretName. In cron and callback contexts the session account is empty, so the check is silently skipped. It runs only when a parent order's stored JSON exists.

verify.confidence: High for the code-verified items. These were re-read on the share: the cited Magento, DMZ, LAN and SS lines, the DMZ Web.config active and commented keys, and Curl.cs. Most of T6's cited file:line references check out: PollCreditStatus, authorizationResult, ProspectTracking, the Hazten schema and cron, CancelOrders, CreditRequest uen, getUrlRegistro, the LAN liberador 'C'-only branch, GetCreditStatus/UpdateCreditOrderId/GetIntelisisStatuses, and the SS commented liberador block and snake_case callback keys. The order-confirmation and comment-email claims are PLAUSIBLE: Magento core (vendor) is not on the share. The duplicate re-send through the Registry cron depends on the setorder_cron config value, which I did not read (no DB access).

result.summary:
Vault cross-check (read-only, 2026-10-07). The vault's main "credito web" documents (CREDITO_WEB_ANALISIS_COMPLETO_Y_PLAN_FINAL, MATRIZ, CAMBIOS, PLAN_EJECUCION, FLUJO_CREDITO_LAN_VS_SAP) cover the CHECKOUT credit order (order/setOrder -> order/new with metodoPago omnipro_pago_credito, client already exists). They say explicitly that this flow does not create clients or prospects (CREDITO:142 G1-11; DU6 CREDITO:328). The account-opening process ("Apertura de cuenta") is covered only in pieces. It appears in three short business notes (Resources/Flujo_Apertura_Cuenta_Mercancia.md, Flujo_Apertura_Cuenta_Sin_Mercancia.md, Flujo_Credilana.md), in group G12 and DEC-22 of PARIDAD_LAN_VS_SERVICIOSAP_2026-10-06, in R9-10/R9-15 of REVISION_PLAN_FABLE_2026-10-02, in the data[] index map of PLAN_EJECUCION §8, and in the SP analysis of ANALISIS_SP_CREDITO_WEB_DATOS §8.

Spot-checking the code shows two entry flows that both stay 100% on LAN through the DMZ (curl.Post to URL_INTELISIS).
(A) Mavi_CreditMigration with tipo APERTURA. Origen is 'APERTURA CUENTA' and the article is AMER00100 (CredilanaManagement.php:84-86; Helper/Data.php:195-200). It runs SaveFirstData/UpdateFirstData/UpdateFirstDom/SaveRef/SaveNip/ValNip against SpCREDISolicitudWebPrimerGuardado. The final save is CreditoWeb_SaveData op 'Insert_2' (CredilanaManagement.php:510), which on LAN goes to CredyPrestamoMethods.CreditoWeb_SaveData. That method generates a prospect number with SP_GeneraConsecutivoCteMavi (IntelisisTmp.TempCteDOS) and inserts CRED_SOLICITUD_WEB_DATOS_TEMP through SP_CREDITO_WEB_DATOS and TrWACW00041_RefSolCredWeb (ServicioAndroid). It returns "id/Pxxxx". Then come SaveIdDatosTemp, a coupon burn 'PW'+id, an Update op (10 s delayed Task.Run), the image upload and a Hazten temp transaction that a Magento cron syncs to credit/SaveHaztenTransaction.
(B) Mavi_ProductosMX. This is the checkout with merchandise: the same PrimerGuardado ops, then CreditoWeb_SaveData_Articulos 'Insert_2' plus article lines through SpVTASInsertArtSolCreditoLinea, then 'Update' (CreditMxManagement.php:465, :513).

The vault decision DEC-22 (PARIDAD:507-515) puts APERTURA inside the Credilana exclusion and defers ProductosMX to Feb-Mar 2027. Nothing of A or B exists in ServicioSAP. Its CreditController only has SendSmsNewNumber, codigoPromocion, getSms, validateSms, getPlazos, GetCreditAmounts, guardardocumento, SaveImagesProductosMx and condicionespago.

Main contradictions with the code:
- SP_GeneraConsecutivoCteMavi is not "orphaned" (ANALISIS:164-176). It runs live in CredyPrestamoMethods.cs:212-226 and Credit/Methods.cs:35-36.
- data[72] IS read by LAN (CreditMethods.cs:480-482), contrary to PLAN:455.
- The Resources apertura notes use a fake op 'InsertarArticulos' and a fake table 'WEB_DATOS_TEMP'. They also miss CreditoWeb_SaveData/SP_CREDITO_WEB_DATOS for the no-merchandise flow.
- FLUJO_CREDITO §9 still says the two apertura SPs are missing; they are in SPsOrden.
- New: the ProductosMX promoter code that overwrites data[14] also reaches @Cp of SpVTASInsertArtSolCreditoLinea (CreditMethods.cs:478, :961).

Vault gaps: there is no mention of the Magento tables mavi_credito_personal, mavi_hazten_credit_transaction or omnipro_credito_sms, the apertura config (need_days/minium_days), getUrlRegistro/validateUser, Mavi_CreditRequest, Vue Storefront, or the screen texts.

Owners: the liberador belongs to Valentin's team (in development, DU11). No business owner is named for apertura, ProductosMX or Credilana. Dev 3 holds the LAN M-xx/E-08 routes, but _NUESTROS_ENDPOINTS/README says "Planed Dev 1". Javier/Dev 2 own prospecto and creditStatus. Alan, the credit area and Dev 2/Marcos own updateCreditOrderId. The DMZ owner and the Magento/Omnipro owner are not named.

It writes the Magento table omnipro_credito_sms (etc/db_schema.xml:6; Model/CreditoManagement.php:308-371), saves the customer (:426) and writes the promoter code into quote.bank (:601). Mavi_CreditMigration uses the same Adapter (Helper/Data.php:26, :40, :56). The opening flow is not only Omnipro_MaviCredito. It reads mavi_hazten_credit_transaction rows with is_c_account = false and updated_at within the last week. For each row it calls GET <config prospectTracking/googleAnalytics url>/{pAccount} through the Adapter, which reaches LAN getCreditAccount -> IntelisisTmp CREDIHProspectoACliente. When a client exists, it sends a GA4 Measurement Protocol event ('Credilana Nuevo Funnel' / 'Paso 9 - Confirmacion Exitosa', label = client account, event_id = prospect). On HTTP 204 it sets c_account and is_c_account = 1. This covers APERTURA, Credilana and ProductosMX, because all three write that table.

ProductosMX post-save chain via an event. saveRequest reserves its own order increment id from the Magento table mavi_productos_mx (7000000001+ for VIU store 2, 8000000001+ otherwise) and sends it as data[66] idMagento. It saves {request_id, increment_id, store_id} to mavi_productos_mx and dispatches 'mavi_new_credit_request'. Observer Mavi_InvoiceDataAnalysis inserts the increment id into mavi_invoice_new_orders. Cron mavi_invoice_data_analysis_check_for_invoices (schedule from config mavi_sistema/intelisisstatus/cron_settings/cron_frecuency) posts the ids to config url_statuses through the Adapter. It also maps ids through omnipro_credito_pending.credit_increment_id. On CONCLUIDO it dispatches mavi_invoice_order_completed (GA4 webhook payload, tipo_pago omnipro_pago_credito for references starting with CRED); on CANCELADO it deletes the row.
